about_the_game:
The B.L.O.O.M (Biotech Lethal Offensive Organic Munitions) Initiative is a fast-paced 2D top-down shoot 'em up where you pilot a drone through procedurally generated battlefields.

         

                  
                   
                   
                   
                   

Harvest, Build & Defend

Your mission: gather resources, plant lethal bio-organisms, and defend your bases from relentless alien and native species on the hostile planet Shlee.

           

From Training to Total War

Start in a basic training drone as you learn to build, plant, and fight, then dive into intense battles as two aggressive alien factions take an interest in your expanding operations.

           

Upgrade, Adapt, and Survive

Upgrade your drone, adapt your strategies, and survive against overwhelming odds in this fusion of action and strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1
  • Processor: Dual-Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10-compatible GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible sound output
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: MonoGame 3.8+ requires .NET 6, so Windows 7 users must install .NET separately. DirectX 9 is deprecated, so target DirectX 10+ for better stability.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Quad-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11+ GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A fast-paced 2D top-down shoot 'em up with single-player and split-screen co-op. Pilot a drone, fight alien hordes, plant and grow bio-weapons, and survive procedurally generated battlefields in a fusion of action and strategy.
